configuration.authorization_change: YouTube-specific forecast fitting on its training dates is now explicitly authorized. The prior transfer-only controller protocol is not silently changed.
configuration.workload_scaling: Preserve the prior common Netflix-training-peak-to-400 multiplier, computed from Traffic_bps/1e6. Apply this same multiplier to both workloads; never consume archived forecast/scaled columns.
configuration.minimum_history_rationale: One complete week before fitting, compared with only two days at the original first prefix; a declared practical minimum, not a proven sufficient sample size. Earliest inner gradient training retains five days.
configuration.selection: Minimum pooled rolling-development RMSE across 672:1680; exact ties prefer persistence, seasonal_daily, boosted_poisson, gru, lstm. No family change after seeing 1680:2016 calibration or external validation.
configuration.prequential_training_provider: Persistence for 96:1008 including the first development block. At later origins use the lowest pooled RMSE on completed earlier development blocks only; at1680 use the already frozen family. No backfilled winner labels.
configuration.cold_start: Persistence until the minimum learned history; keep all original 1920 scored training timestamps. First development block uses persistence until comparative evidence exists.

neural.refit: Select epoch on last96 earlier-prefix targets, then reinitialize same seed and refit all available prefix targets for that many epochs. No forecast-block outcomes select epochs.
neural.lstm: Existing Stage4 SpatialDropout .1, LSTM128/LSTM64 dropout .2, Dense64 ReLU/dropout .2, softplus head; recurrent dropout0
neural.gru: GRU32, Dense16 ReLU, softplus; no additional search

boosted.features: 96 ordered load lags plus six decision calendar features, last4/16/96 means and last completed increment. All deterministic functions of the same causal information.

configuration.full_prefix_diagnostics: Fit all three learned families at2016 with training-only epoch selection. Frozen family alone defines the service. Other full-prefix fits provide prespecified secondary validation diagnostics only.
configuration.search_budget: Per workload three learned families at origins672/1008/1344/1680 and full2016: 15 artifact fits. Each neural artifact has at most60 inner-stopping epochs and at most60 full-prefix refit epochs. Total40 neural optimization stages,10 boosted fits across both workloads; no expansion.
configuration.uncertainty: Report fold/block and day errors descriptively; no calibrated physical confidence or equivalence claim from three development blocks.

hysteresis_proposal.k_origin: Declared unit multiplier, not optimized; the paper's approximate26/24.70 ratio is recorded descriptively, not assumed an authenticated historical k.
hysteresis_proposal.primary_mae: Selected family OOF MAE on the separate training calibration block1680:2016
hysteresis_proposal.literal_paper_comparison: Also report selected final provider training in-sample MAE and implied in-sample margin; using OOF error is an explicit correction for optimism. No baseline is modified.

runtime.batch_policy: one sample per forward pass, independent of caller batching
runtime.input_pipeline: float32(load/k) -> float32 log1p -> saved input scaler
runtime.output_pipeline: float32 model output -> saved target inverse scaler; no clipping
runtime.serialized_tensorflow_version_note: Not recorded in the .keras metadata; not inferred from Keras version

source_direction_and_units: Read raw Traffic_bps/1e6, preserve common Netflix-training workload scale. No physically invented cap or resampling.
